278040940.description:
Weber & Unbranded
Smoking Pipe Lot - Briar Wood and Composite
Vintage, Set of 3 with Wooden Storage Rack
This collection of vintage smoking pipes features a variety of finishes, including one confirmed Weber pipe, presented in a dedicated wooden storage rack. These pieces represent mid-20th-century tobacco accessories, showcasing classic shapes crafted from briar wood, valued for its heat resistance and distinctive grain. The lot includes a mix of smooth and rusticated textures, providing a comprehensive starter set or addition to a growing collection.
Three pipes included: one smooth orange-toned briar, one rusticated dark briar, and one dark-stained smooth pipe
Weber brand mark clearly visible on the shank of the smooth orange-toned briar pipe
Custom light-wood storage rack featuring three bored slots for upright pipe display
Overall rack height measures approximately 6 inches based on scale in photographs
Condition:
Good vintage condition consistent with previous use. Pipe bowls show interior charring and carbon buildup from use. Stems exhibit light oxidation and minor chatter marks near the bits. The wooden storage rack is structurally stable with minor surface scuffs and dust in recessed areas. No structural cracks detected in the briar wood components.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR PURCHASE!
If you’re happy and you know it, please leave a 5-star rating! If there is a problem with your order, please contact us via Shop Goodwill before opening returns/claims. We strive to return all messages within one business day.
Please click the shipping estimate link in the listing to get the shipping costs directly from FedEx.  There will be no discounts or price changes after an auction has ended.
Our shipping team works hard to get out all orders as quickly as possible, that being said it may take up to 5 business days after payment for your order to ship out.  Once it ships out you will receive tracking information.
***IMPORTANT*** If your item was damaged in transit, do not throw away anything, including the box or packing materials until we have authorized you to do so. Photos will be required to file insurance claims.
Our Business hours: Monday - Friday  8:00 am to 4:00 pm Central
New items and unique treasures are added daily, come back soon!
